projectState.summary: Track A2 is approved and merged to main. The durable Claude review artifact from claude/codex-a2-fitness-aggregation-code-review was cherry-picked, and the pure candidate fitness ruler is ready for Track A3. A2 adds src/candidate-fitness.ts with a pure weighted scalar aggregator, contribution breakdown, missing-score penalty, ignored-key reporting, and copy-only candidate fitness preview. The helper is exposed through window.persistence for inspection only; it does not write to SQLite and no audio/model/playback/selection/cap path consumes it. Carry forward: fitness is meaningful only within a candidate kind for now, and A4 must deep-clone genomes before mutation. Next: Track A3 deterministic top-N-per-kind elite selection and overflow purge using existing candidate-store mutation/audit APIs.
